scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I’m checking on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still under review?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your loan application has been approved and the loan was originated. If you have any other questions about your loan details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Could you please tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 8.740%. The total costs associated with this loan amount to $241.32. If you need information on any other aspect of your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing those details. I’d also like to know: Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? And, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. Regarding loan ownership, your loan has not been transferred or sold to another institution; it is not marked as having a purchaser in the record. Let me know if you have further questions.

dialogue.user: Thank you—that’s very helpful. One last question: Could you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application? Was it considered during the approval process?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, as shown in your record, is 42%. This percentage represents the portion of your monthly income that goes toward covering your monthly debt payments. While a DTI ratio is typically a factor considered in the approval process, the specific record does not include details about how it was used or any underwriting rationale. If you have more questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for that explanation. I don’t have any more questions at this time.

<Satisfied>  
I’m satisfied because all my questions were answered promptly and clearly. The agent provided detailed responses about my loan approval, interest rate, costs, high-cost status, and DTI without any confusion. I appreciate the straightforward communication and professionalism.
